verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Rippling's REST API (tokens, versioning, pagination) but no mention of webhooks, event hooks, or subscribable identity/lifecycle event streams for downstream systems to consume in real time. Automations described are internal (e.g., custom workflows, offboarding triggers) rather than developer-facing event subscriptions. missing for 10: webhook/event subscription API, documented event types (user created/deleted/auth events), delivery/retry mechanics, any developer-facing pub/sub or callback registration.
